MOLECULAR GENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Service

PATIENT INFORMATION
Name: [redacted name]
DOB: [redacted date]
MRN: [redacted ID]
Specimen ID: [redacted ID]
Specimen Type: Peripheral blood
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

REFERRAL REASON
Diagnostic testing for genetic susceptibility to BRCA-related cancer.

METHODOLOGY
Bidirectional DNA sequencing and Multiplex Ligation-dependent Probe Amplification (MLPA) analysis of BRCA1 (NM_007294.3) and BRCA2 (NM_000059.3) genes was performed.

DNA was extracted from peripheral blood using standard protocols. All coding exons and intron-exon boundaries of BRCA1 and BRCA2 were amplified by PCR and analyzed by bidirectional Sanger sequencing. Generic MLPA kits were utilized to test all exons of both genes for large deletions and duplications.

Technical Notes:
- DNA sequencing detects >99% of point mutations and microlesions
- MLPA analysis detects large deletions and duplications not identifiable by sequencing
- Combined analysis detects >98% of BRCA1/BRCA2 mutations
- This test does not detect deep intronic variants or regulatory region mutations

RESULTS

BRCA1 (NM_007294.3):
No pathogenic mutations detected
Complete coding regions and splice sites screened
No large deletions or duplications detected by MLPA

BRCA2 (NM_000059.3):
No pathogenic mutations detected
Complete coding regions and splice sites screened
No large deletions or duplications detected by MLPA

SUMMARY
No pathogenic mutations were identified in the BRCA1 or BRCA2 genes. The patient is very unlikely to have a pathogenic mutation in BRCA1 or BRCA2 genes.

LIMITATIONS
This test has a clinical sensitivity of >98% for detecting pathogenic variants in BRCA1 and BRCA2. A negative result does not exclude the possibility of:
- Mutations in regions not covered by this analysis
- Mutations in other cancer susceptibility genes
- Mutations below the detection threshold of the methodologies used

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD
Authorized by: [redacted name], MD, PhD
Clinical Molecular Geneticist
